# Claim-boundary concern

Use this when a doc, example, issue, or code path may be overstating what the kernel proves.

## Concern

What language or behavior may be overclaiming?

## Location

File, receipt, example, or section.

## Suggested safer wording

Propose a bounded version.

## Recommended tag

- FORMAL
- COMPUTED
- MODEL
- INTERPRETIVE
- METAPHOR
- OBSERVED
- FAILED
